hub.seoTitle: Mobility & Languages — Learn, prepare and find your way, free of charge
hub.seoDescription: WAHHF Foundation: a free German/English/Italian Language Academy (A1 to C1) and transparent support towards 10 European countries, funded by our partners and donors.
hub.title: Learn German/English/Italian, prepare and find your way to Europe
hub.intro: German/English/Italian courses from level A1 to level C1 and reliable information on studies, training and work in 10 European countries.
hub.portesSubtitle: You can apply for the German/English/Italian language courses only, for the support with your documents only, or for both.
hub.academieText: Learn German/English/Italian step by step: comprehension, speaking and writing, an online placement test and methodical preparation for certificates.
hub.europeText: A 4-step learning path to understand the legal routes (studies, vocational training, work), prepare your application file and check every step on the official portals.
hub.pourquoiTitle: Protecting young people from misinformation and opening up access to knowledge
hub.pourquoiSubtitle: Too many young people and families get into debt with fraudulent middlemen who sell false promises. WAHHF Foundation responds with linguistic rigour and transparency.
hub.pourquoiText: A plan to study or train abroad cannot be bought: it is built through demanding language learning, qualifications that meet the requirements and strict compliance with official consular procedures.

frais.title: No fees for beneficiaries
frais.desc: No registration fees, no application fees, no commission at any stage.

arnaques.title: Actively fighting scams
arnaques.desc: A guide to spotting fake contracts and fake visas, and to checking every piece of information against official sources.

exigence.title: Academic and language standards
exigence.desc: Step-by-step support from beginner level A1 to university-level independence at C1.

gratuit.q: Are the German/English/Italian courses and the support really 100% free?
gratuit.a: Yes, for all beneficiaries: the German/English/Italian courses, from level A1 to level C1, as well as the guidance sessions on Europe. The programme is funded by our partners and donors.

visas.q: Does WAHHF Foundation issue visas or employment contracts?
visas.a: No, never. WAHHF Foundation is a non-profit foundation. We do not sell visas, university places or employment contracts, and we guarantee no outcome. Decisions rest solely with embassies, consulates and official institutions.

identite.q: Do I need to send my passport or ID card to apply?
identite.a: No. When you apply online on this site, you are not asked for any identity document (no passport, no national ID card) or any money.

niveau.q: How do I know which German/English/Italian level to start at?
niveau.a: If you are a complete beginner, choose level A1. If you already know the basics, take our 20-question placement test on the Language Academy page.

hub.finSubtitle: One form for the German/English/Italian courses and guidance towards Europe. It takes about 5 minutes; you will not be asked for any identity document or payment.

a1.subtitle: Understand and use familiar, everyday expressions.
a1.prerequisites: No prior German required. Open to complete beginners.
objectives: Master the alphabet, pronunciation and simple sentence structures
Introduce yourself and ask simple questions about your immediate surroundings
Learn everyday vocabulary (family, housing, shopping, times)
canDo: Introduce yourself and someone else in German
Fill in a simple form with your personal details
Understand short announcements and simple directions
a1.examTarget: Preparation for the Goethe-Zertifikat A1: Start Deutsch 1 / telc Deutsch A1 (TODO: to be checked)

a2.subtitle: Communicate in simple, routine everyday tasks.
a2.prerequisites: Have completed level A1 or passed the free placement test.
objectives: Talk about your schooling, your surroundings and your immediate needs
Master the perfect tense (Perfekt), modal verbs and basic subordinate clauses
Read short emails, information notices and everyday documents
canDo: Describe your education and experience in simple terms
Talk about familiar topics (health, work, travel)
a2.examTarget: Preparation for the Goethe-Zertifikat A2 / telc Deutsch A2 (TODO: to be checked)

b1.subtitle: Cope independently in most travel, study or training situations.
objectives: Understand the main points of a clear discussion about work, school or leisure
Recount an event, explain a plan for studies or vocational training (Ausbildung)
Write a cover letter and a CV to German-speaking standards
canDo: Join a conversation on familiar topics without preparation
Briefly defend an opinion or explain the path you have chosen
Manage everyday administrative procedures in German
b1.examTarget: Preparation for the Goethe-Zertifikat B1 / telc Deutsch B1 (TODO: to be checked)

b2.subtitle: Communicate spontaneously and understand complex texts.
objectives: Understand the main content of concrete or abstract topics in a complex text
Take part in technical discussions in your field
Express yourself clearly, in detail and with nuance, both orally and in writing
canDo: Follow preparatory courses or demanding vocational training in German
Argue in a structured way in an academic or job interview
Write precise summaries and formal letters
b2.examTarget: Preparation for the Goethe-Zertifikat B2 / telc Deutsch B2 (TODO: to be checked)

c1.subtitle: Use the language flexibly and effectively in university and social life.
objectives: Understand a wide range of long, demanding texts and grasp implicit meaning
Express yourself fluently and spontaneously without obviously searching for words
Master the methods of scientific and academic writing at university
canDo: Follow a full university degree programme in German
Give complex presentations and answer detailed questions
Write well-structured texts on complex academic topics
c1.examTarget: Preparation for the TestDaF / Goethe-Zertifikat C1 / telc Deutsch C1 Hochschule (TODO: to be checked)
